findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/gates-exec.js:spawnAsync::a unit that exits at the same moment as a cut is recorded as cut
findings.title: a unit that exits at the same moment as a cut is recorded as cut
findings.action: Only report a cut when the child was still alive.
findings.disposition_rationale: The window is a unit closing in the same tick the timer fires. Cut-wins fails toward safety: a budget cut is discarded and re-run next call, and a ceiling cut records exceeds-call-budget (needs-human). Treating an exit code after SIGTERM as a result would instead let npm-style wrappers that exit 143 on SIGTERM record a cut as a fail.

occurrences.title: a unit that exits at the same moment as a cut is recorded as cut

findings.title: gitignored inputs of whole or shard rungs are outside both fingerprints
findings.action: Hash a whole rung command file.
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec 4.2 chooses this explicitly: ignored files other than pool test files stay outside both fingerprints, covered by the one-hour stale bound and by CI, which re-runs everything.
